title: ZgukistringZ
statementMd:
Professor GukiZ doesn't accept string as they are. He likes to swap some letters in string to obtain a new one.

GukiZ has strings $*a*$, $*b*$, and $*c*$. He wants to obtain string $*k*$ by swapping some letters in $*a*$, so that $*k*$ should contain as many non-overlapping substrings equal either to $*b*$ or $*c*$ as possible. Substring of string $*x*$ is a string formed by consecutive segment of characters from $*x*$. Two substrings of string $*x*$ overlap if there is position $*i*$ in string $*x*$ occupied by both of them.

GukiZ was disappointed because none of his students managed to solve the problem. Can you help them and find one of possible strings $*k*$?

## Input

The first line contains string $*a*$, the second line contains string $*b*$, and the third line contains string $*c*$ ($1 ≤ |*a*|, |*b*|, |*c*| ≤ 10^{5}$, where $|*s*|$ denotes the length of string $*s*$).

All three strings consist only of lowercase English letters.

It is possible that $*b*$ and $*c*$ coincide.

## Output

Find one of possible strings $*k*$, as described in the problem statement. If there are multiple possible answers, print any of them.

## Note

In the third sample, this optimal solutions has three non-overlaping substrings equal to either $*b*$ or $*c*$ on positions $1 – 2$ ($*ab*$), $3 – 4$ ($*ab*$), $5 – 7$ ($*aca*$). In this sample, there exist many other optimal solutions, one of them would be $*acaababbcc*$.
statementZhMd:
GukiZ 教授不喜欢字符串原本的样子。他喜欢交换字符串中的一些字符来得到一个新的字符串。

GukiZ 有字符串 $*a*$、$*b*$ 和 $*c*$。他希望通过交换 $*a*$ 中的一些字符得到字符串 $*k*$，使得 $*k*$ 中包含尽可能多的、互不重叠且等于 $*b*$ 或 $*c*$ 的子串。字符串 $*x*$ 的子串是由 $*x*$ 中一段连续的字符构成的字符串。如果字符串 $*x*$ 的两个子串所占据的位置中存在某个位置 $*i*$ 同时属于它们，则称这两个子串重叠。

GukiZ 很失望，因为他的学生中没有人成功解决这个问题。你能帮助他们，找出一个可能的字符串 $*k*$ 吗？

## 输入格式

第一行包含字符串 $*a*$，第二行包含字符串 $*b*$，第三行包含字符串 $*c*$（$1 ≤ |*a*|, |*b*|, |*c*| ≤ 10^{5}$，其中 $|*s*|$ 表示字符串 $*s*$ 的长度）。

三个字符串都只包含小写英文字母。

$*b*$ 和 $*c*$ 可能相同。

## 输出格式

按照题目描述，输出一个可能的字符串 $*k*$。如果有多个可能的答案，输出其中任意一个即可。

## 说明

在第三个样例中，这个最优解在位置 $1 – 2$（$*ab*$）、$3 – 4$（$*ab*$）和 $5 – 7$（$*aca*$）处包含三个互不重叠且等于 $*b*$ 或 $*c*$ 的子串。在这个样例中，还存在许多其他最优解，其中一个是 $*acaababbcc*$。
